period_note: Balance sheet is the 31-Mar-2023 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2023 (Q1=3 months). Source PDF text layer is present but scattered corruption is typical of this vintage; figures below use a fresh OCR pass (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) rather than the raw pdftotext extraction, which is materially more reliable for this filing (e.g. pdftotext mis-read paid_up_capital comparative as 9,801,424,190 and gross_loans comparative as 225,709,296,939; OCR correctly reads 9,807,424,780 and 225,709,286,939, both of which match this dataset's existing 2022_Q4.json EXACTLY). Comparative (31-Dec-2022) column additionally matches 2022_Q4.json exactly for total_assets (314,841.323539m), total_equity (18,379.798831m), total_deposits (226,059.482332m) and off_balance_sheet_exposures (61,901.836582m). Balance-sheet identity holds exactly for the current period (292,646.037388 + 18,559.604584 = 311,205.641972); total_equity itself is independently confirmed as the exact sum of its own components (paid-up 9,807.42478 + statutory reserve 7,191.242045 + P&L surplus 1,232.115495 + revaluation reserve 328.822264 = 18,559.604584). statutory_reserve is corroborated by the bank's 20%-of-PBT rule: prior year-end (7,131.286231m) + 20% of this quarter's profit-before-tax (299.779068m x 20% = 59.955814m) = 7,191.242045m, matching exactly. Income statement fully reconciles: operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (2,388.417133-1,709.900914=678.516219 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (678.516219-378.737152=678.516219-378.737152=299.779067, matches 299.779068 reported); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (299.779068-25.969362=273.809706, matches 273.809705 reported). eps_cumulative was illegible for the current-period column in both OCR passes (only the 2022 comparative '0.41' survived); CALCULATED as profit_after_tax / weighted-average shares outstanding (273.809705m / 980.742478m shares = 0.28). Paid-up capital (9,807.42478m) is unchanged from 31-Dec-2022 - the bonus issue that raised it to 10,297.79601m happened between 30-Jun-2023 and 30-Sep-2023 (see 2023_Q2.json / 2023_Q3.json).
